title: ‘Marvelous Mrs. Maisel’ Set Decorator Mary Kate Golding Fatally Stabbed in N.Y.
content:
ByPat Saperstein

Deputy Editor

Mary Kate Golding, a set decorator for shows including “The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel,” “Goosebumps” and  “Mr. and Mrs. Smith” died Tuesday in Queens, N.Y. after being stabbed. She was 34.

Police were called to her apartment just after midnight. The NYPD said in a statement, “On Tuesday, July 21, 2026, at approximately 0024 hours, police responded to a 911 call of an assault inside of 18-64 41 Street, within the confines of the 114 Precinct. Upon arrival, officers observed a 34-year-old female victim with a stab wound to the back. EMS responded and pronounced the victim deceased on the scene.”

A few hours later, Golding’s husband, Joseph Azzaretto, was found dead by hanging at Astoria Park around 6:39 a.m. A murder-suicide is suspected, according to multiple media reports. The couple’s baby son was found at their home, but was not hurt.

The NYPD said, “On Tuesday, July 21, 2026, at approximately 0639 hours, police responded to a 911 call of an unconscious person in the vicinity of Astoria Park South and Shore Boulevard, within the confines of the 114th Precinct. Upon arrival, officers discovered an unidentified male, approximately 30 to 35 years of age, unconscious and unresponsive inside the park. EMS responded and pronounced the male deceased on scene.”

Golding was set to work on Sean Durkin’s upcoming film “Deep Cuts.” Her previous credits as a set decorator include “Gone Girls: The Long Island Serial Killer,” “Full Circle,” “Extrapolations,” “Marry Me” and “Hawkeye.”

After attending NYU, her first credit came as an assistant on Michael Showalter’s “The Big Sick,” and she went on to work on “Time After Time,” “An Imperfect Murder,” “Cruise,” “Deception,” “Gotham,” “Lisey’s Story” and “The Flight Attendant.”

Years earlier, Azzaretto’s brother shot his father, Frank Azzaretto, dead during a fight with his mother,the Daily Newsreported. Frank Azzaretto had worked in the art department on the “Daredevil” TV series and on “Unforgettable.”
title_zh: 《了不起的麥瑟爾夫人》(The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel) 的佈景設計師瑪麗·凱特·戈爾丁(Mary Kate Golding)在紐約遭到致命刺傷。
content_zh:
由帕特·薩珀斯坦(Pat Saperstein)報導

副編輯

瑪麗·凱特·戈爾丁(Mary Kate Golding)，曾參與《了不起的麥瑟爾夫人》(The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel)、《驚聲尖叫》(Goosebumps)和《史密斯夫婦》(Mr. and Mrs. Smith)等節目的佈景設計師，於週二在紐約皇后區被刺身亡，享年34歲。

警方在午夜過後接到報案，前往她的公寓。紐約市警察局(NYPD)在一份聲明中表示：“在2026年7月21日星期二，約凌晨12:24，警方接到911報案，稱在114區的18-64 41街內發生襲擊事件。到達現場後，警員發現一名34歲女性受害者背部有刺傷。緊急醫療服務(EMS)到達並宣告受害者當場死亡。”

幾個小時後，戈爾丁的丈夫約瑟夫·阿扎雷托(Joseph Azzaretto)於早上6:39在阿斯托里亞公園被發現上吊身亡。根據多家媒體報導，警方懷疑這是一宗謀殺自殺案。這對夫婦的嬰兒兒子在家中被找到，但並未受傷。

紐約市警察局表示：“在2026年7月21日星期二，約早上6:39，警方接到911報案，稱在阿斯托里亞公園南部和海岸大道附近發現一名昏迷者，位於114區內。到達現場後，警員發現一名約30至35歲的男性在公園內昏迷且無反應。EMS到達並宣告該男性當場死亡。”

戈爾丁原定參與肖恩·達金(Sean Durkin)即將上映的電影《深層切割》(Deep Cuts)的工作。她之前的佈景設計作品包括《消失的女孩：長島連環殺手》(Gone Girls: The Long Island Serial Killer)、《全圈》(Full Circle)、《外推》(Extrapolations)、《嫁給我》(Marry Me)和《鷹眼》(Hawkeye)。

在紐約大學(NYU)就讀後，她的第一個工作是作為邁克爾·肖沃特(Michael Showalter)的《大病》(The Big Sick)的助理，之後她參與了《時光倒流》(Time After Time)、《不完美的謀殺》(An Imperfect Murder)、《巡航》(Cruise)、《欺騙》(Deception)、《哥譚》(Gotham)、《莉西的故事》(Lisey’s Story)和《空中小姐》(The Flight Attendant)等作品。

幾年前，阿扎雷托的兄弟在與母親爭吵時，開槍打死了他的父親弗蘭克·阿扎雷托(Frank Azzaretto)，《每日新聞》(Daily News)報導。弗蘭克·阿扎雷托曾在《惡棍》(Daredevil)電視劇和《難以忘懷》(Unforgettable)的美術部工作。
